verdict.rationale: monday.com's own marketing says users can build custom agents in the product: they describe a workflow in natural language, define goals and rules, and an admin can scope each agent's board access. Developers can also ship agent skills. The evidence is vendor marketing copy only, and it gives little detail on how agents are configured. missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on the agent builder's configuration options (tools, triggers, memory, model choice per agent), independent or hands-on corroboration that end users can build and configure agents as claimed.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build and configure my own custom AI agent within the product

citations.quote: Build agents for your exact needs. Define the goal, set the rules, watch the results.
Describe any workflow in your own words to create a unique agent in minutes.
Scope each agent's board access from the admin, audit every action it takes
Ship new reusable workflow blocks, agent skills, and board column types.
